Bagchi as an Additional Director and as the Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer 
of HDFC Bank Limited (‘the Bank’) in place of Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan 
 
In furtherance to our intimation dated September 12, 2026, we wish to inform you that pursuant to an 
application made by the Bank to the Reserve Bank of India (“RBI”), the RBI vide its communication 
dated October 1, 2026, has approved appointment of Mr. Anup Bagchi (DIN: 00105962) as the 
Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer (“ MD & CEO ”) of the Bank and the remuneration 
payable to him, under Section 35B of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 for a period of 3 (three) years 
with effect from October 27, 2026.  
 
Consequently, the Board of Directors of the Bank, based on the recommendation of the Governance, 
Nomination and Remuneration Committee, at its meeting held today i.e. October 1, 2026 approved the 
following: 
 
a. appointment of Mr. Anup Bagchi as an Additional Director of the Bank w.e.f. October 2, 2026 till 
the date of approval of the shareholders as per the provisions of Companies Act, 2013; and 
 
b. appointment of Mr. Anup Bagchi as the MD & CEO of the Bank on such terms and conditions 
including remuneration, as approved by the RBI, for a period of 3 (three) years with effect from 
October 27, 2026, subject to approval of the shareholders as per the provisions of Companies Act, 
2013.

Annexure I 
 
Profile of Mr. Anup Bagchi 
 
Mr. Anup Bagchi is a seasoned financial services leader with over three decades of experience across 
banking, capital markets, wealth management and insurance. A member of the ICICI Group since 1992, 
he has built a diverse career spanning treasury, retail banking, wholesale banking, investment banking, 
and digital financial services. Over the course of his career, he has held several pivotal leadership 
positions, including CEO & MD of ICICI Securities, Executive Director of ICICI Bank, and currently 
MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance. His career reflects a strong track record of business 
building, strategic leadership, and navigating the evolving financial services landscape. 
 
Mr. Bagchi served as Executive Director of ICICI Bank from 2017 to 2023, overseeing Retail, Business 
and Rural Banking, and subsequently Wholesale Banking. During his tenure, he played a key role in 
strengthening the bank's retail franchise, driving profitable growth while maintaining credit and cost 
discipline. Under his leadership, ICICI Bank became the first private-sector bank in India to surpass a 
retail mortgage portfolio of Rs. 2 trillion and successfully navigated the demonetisation period with 
limited business disruption. Alongside his executive responsibilities, he served as Chairman of ICICI 
Prudential Asset Management Company until May 2023 and was a Director of ICICI Prudential 
Pension Funds Management Company and ICICI Home Finance. 
 
Since June 2023, Mr. Bagchi has been serving as MD & CEO of ICICI Prudential Life Insurance, 
leading one of India's largest private life insurers, which is publicly listed. Under his leadership, the 
company crossed Rs. 10,000 crore in Annualised Premium Equivalent (APE) for the first time in 
FY2025, with APE growing 15% year-on-year to Rs. 10,407 crore and profit after tax increasing nearly 
40% to Rs. 1,189 crore. The business has also delivered strong growth in protection products and new 
business generation, reflecting his focus on sustainable and profitable expansion. 
 
Mr. Anup Bagchi holds Management degree from Indian Institute of Management, Bangalore and an 
Engineering degree from Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur.

Mitrankur (Mit) Majumdar is the Executive Vice President and Global Head of the SURE segment at

collaborates with C-suite leaders across Global 2000 organizations and high-growth enterprises to

education, engineering, construction, and real estate industrie s. His deep understanding of

build more resilient, adaptive, and future-ready enterprises.

Regulation 44 of the Listing Regulations.

Brief Profile of Mr. Akhil Ravi 
 
 
 
Akhil Ravi brings nearly 19 years of experience spanning strategy, commercial leadership, business 
transformation and general management. Since joining Dr. Reddy's Laboratories in 2018, he has held 
leadership roles across strategy, commercial operations and business leadership, and currently serves as 
CEO of Aurigene Pharmaceutical Services Ltd. (APSL) , a wholly owned subsidiary of Dr. Reddy’s 
Laboratories. In this role, he has led APSL's evolution from a start -up-style business into a rapidly scaling 
CRDMO, driving significant growth, profitability and capability expansion. 
Since joining Dr. Reddy’s, Akhil has led the transformation of APSL through a multi-year agenda focused 
on strengthening operating foundations, accelerating growth, improving profitability and enhancing 
customer service. Under his leadership, the business is on track and on growth trajectory. He has also driven 
a significant improvement in service levels across the CDMO business, strengthening both operational 
performance and customer confidence. 
Akhil has been instrumental in advancing APSL's innovation and technology capabilities. He led the 
implementation of Aurigene.ai, an AI -enabled integrated drug discovery workflow that now supports 
approximately 30% of the drug discovery services business. He has also overseen the expansion of 
capabilities across drug discovery, antibodies, biologics, APIs and peptides, while laying the foundation for 
growth in the drug product CDMO business through strategic partnerships. 
  

 
 
Before joining Dr. Reddy's, Akhil held sales and transformation roles at McKinsey & Company and ITC  
and also pursued entrepreneurial ventures focused on digital sports and health solutions. 
Akhil has done Post -Graduate Programme in Management  from Indian School of Business (ISB) and
